name: @psyb0t/hybrids3
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted hybrids3 object storage service over MCP — upload, download, list, and delete objects as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running hybrids3 instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp/), exposing its object storage tools: upload_object, download_object, delete_object, list_objects, list_buckets, object_info, and presign_url. hybrids3 is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-hybrids3.

HYBRIDS3_URL.description: Base URL of your running hybrids3 server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp/).

HYBRIDS3_KEY.description: Bearer token — a bucket's private key or the master key, only if the hybrids3 endpoint requires connection-level auth.

url.description: Base URL of your running hybrids3 server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp/).

token.description: Bearer token — a bucket's private key or the master key, only if the hybrids3 endpoint requires connection-level auth.
